evidence.quote: Forget everything about the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts.

observations.why: Imperative directive issued by a named participant to an audience, enacting command hierarchy rather than proposal or negotiation.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge of zeppelin routes.

observations.why: Second imperative command reinforcing the same authority-ranking enactment — a directive to purge information, not a request.

mints.title: Forget everything about … Remove all knowledge of …
